label-palette.description: Path to the label palette file. Note that it may be edited and over-written - make sure it is backed up / under version control.

dataset-roots.description: List of read only data set root paths (each root will be searched recursively for audio files

export-prefix.description: Prefix path to export output files, including filename minus extension

export.description: Clip export settings. Every key is optional.

directory.description: Output directory, relative to this file. Default: dataset

mode.description: padded: each label plus padding, merging labels whose clips would overlap. fixed: a window of fixed length centred on each label. Default: padded

padding_s.description: Padding before and after each label, and the gap kept between background clips and labels. Default: 0.5

fixed_length_s.description: Clip length in fixed mode. Default: 10

max_clip_s.description: Merging stops before a clip would exceed this. Default: 30

background_per_file.description: Clips with no labels, from files marked done. Default: 0
